title: C-UAS Case of a Group Factory in Nigeria
title_en: C-UAS Case of a Group Factory in Nigeria
description:
2025 C-UAS Case of a Group Factory in Nigeria
Equipment Used:
Mobile Spectrum Identification Equipment
Signal Verification Equipment
Command and Control Platform
Project Introduction:
In 2025, this industrial-park project deployed a mobile C-UAS early-warning operation for production areas, logistics roads, and perimeter checkpoints. Mobile spectrum identification equipment supports flexible coverage across large sites, while signal verification and the command platform help operators identify, position, track, review airspace events, retain records, and coordinate compliant response procedures. The public-facing description is limited to early warning, identification, positioning, tracking, event records, and process coordination.
